summary: Built 1934 in Butternut per the 2024 chapter report, moved to Park Falls, then bought from the DNR and moved to private land in 2018. Not gone.

facts.design: Appears to be a standard 100-foot Aermotor tower with a US Forest Service-style stairway, per NHLR; the register says year and height are unknown
facts.status_note: Moved off the Park Falls site in 2018. The 2024 and 2025 chapter reports place it on private property less than five miles from Park Falls.
facts.agency: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (administrator per NHLR; sold the tower in 2018 per the chapter reports)

access.note: On private property less than five miles from the former Park Falls site, per the 2024 and 2025 chapter reports. The reports describe no visiting arrangements.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the year of construction is unknown. The 2024 chapter report says it was erected in 1934 in Butternut. The story gives the chapter's 1934 date and says it rests on the chapter report alone, because NHLR gives no year.

notes_for_editor: The 1934 Butternut date rests on the chapter report alone; NHLR says the year is unknown. Chapter reports name a private owner, who is deliberately left out of the story. The brief's 'gone' status is wrong: the tower was moved in 2018, not lost. The move from Butternut to Park Falls has no date in any source read. No photo finds.
